name: gap3_suite_n
setup: 23 windows x 3 seeds = 69 paired runs; systems naive/bar(sync+med3+nlm)/ours(P22); 12 CI shards; paired deltas + cluster bootstrap over 4 non-overlapping content clusters
caveat: content = ONE 280-frame source (imageio ships a single sample video); windows overlap up to 50 frames; 4 content clusters only, so cluster CIs are coarse. Seeds sample damage randomness, not scene diversity.

name: gap2_bar_verdict
question: does the lost/roll/fades edge survive once SSIM and flicker are at parity?
answer: PARTIAL. On good frames SSIM is at exact parity (+0.001 [-0.014, +0.016]); static flicker is NOT at parity (bar 1.76 vs ours 3.78, delta +2.02 [+1.20, +2.91]); ours wins tdiff flicker (-0.365). The PSNR edge is NOT confined to damaged frames: p.good +1.84 [+1.27, +2.44], p.lost +3.37 (largest single margin), p.roll +1.30, p.fades +1.37. Ours = PSNR + tdiff-flicker specialist; bar = static-flicker + SSIM specialist. Blind A/B on real footage remains the arbiter (standing rule).
sync_value_replicated: bar - naive +2.99 [+2.81, +3.17] on N=69 (test clip attribution was +2.96)

name: gap1_chroma_fair
setup: chroma-dominant profile (hue instability, sat pumping, heavy chroma noise, chroma streaks+bleed, chroma-only echo, comb-filter leakage; NO roll/lost/dropout/jitter); tune clip c0 grid-selected on CHROMA PSNR; 7 clips scored once; flugbild rm50 fb50, anahd no_look=True
split_verdict: flugbild WINS chroma PSNR (+0.54 mean; 4/7 clips clearly), Y PSNR (+0.78), saturation ratio. OURS WINS chroma flicker (5.13 vs 13.09), hue stability (58 vs 74 deg), SSIM (0.666 vs 0.359). AnaHD classic is BELOW naive even on its home turf (chroma 16.29 vs 16.79; Y 19.73 catastrophic). Claim adjusted: flugbild is not beaten on chroma magnitude fidelity in its envelope.
caveats: tools output through their own encoders (crf 10/12/14) vs ours pre-encoder; slow hue drift is unfixable by every system (shared handicap); N=7 competitor clips.
